value.rationale: The two concentrations and the autocatalytic transfer uv² are canonical observables of a natural reaction model with nontrivial homogeneous periodic dynamics. Beyond routine generator orthogonality, the paired calibrated conditional nullclines yield exact measurable kinetic activity and rigidity for all compact positive invariant probability measures without ergodicity, and the two-calibration essential-supremum argument yields explicit parameter-sharp concentration envelopes U≤u+ and v≥(F+k)/u+. The upper envelope is attained at the positive equilibrium (u+, (F+k)/u+), so it can test numerically estimated stationary phase portraits and periodic-orbit concentration bounds. This is a motivated structural invariant/constraint, not a new saddle-node theorem or broad dynamics classification.
